_comment: FR-09 fit classifier. Weights from the CS4085 Deep Learning project (github.com/Hams770/HireMind-DL), frozen deployment seed 42. The platform refuses to load a weights file whose SHA-256 differs from the value below.
name: M0_s42_lr0.0001
review_rule: A candidate is flagged 'possible Good Fit, HR review' when P(Good Fit) >= review_threshold. Chosen on the validation split only (test results are not used for choosing): the highest threshold (step 0.025) that still flags at least half of the Good Fit pairs of the validation split. On validation 0.225 flags 34.5% of pairs and catches 56.1% of Good Fit, against 23.9% for the predicted label alone. See test-results/fit_model_report.md.
